decisions.statement: One healthy check clears every failure and every respawn counted so far.
A proxy is respawned only after three checks in a row failed.
Three respawns in a row that never reached health is where the supervisor gives up.
A supervisor that gave up counts no further failure and acts no further.
A respawn clears the failure count and raises the respawn count.
Nothing here checks health or spawns a proxy.

definition: what a supervisor does as the OAuth proxy fails its health checks
